title: Why 0 Titanic Skeletons Exist at the Wreck Site
description:
Why have oceanographers found zero titanic skeletons across the seafloor, while leather shoes remain untouched for over a century?

At 3,800 meters down, hydrostatic pressure, mineral-undersaturated seawater, and bone-eating microbes gradually dissolve calcium-phosphate crystals until exposed human bones vanish. However, early 20th-century bootmakers cured leather with oak-bark tannic acid, creating a rot-resistant polymer that deep-sea bacteria cannot digest.
